title: Izwi Elahlanganisa Izintaba
intro: Umphefumulo olungileyo wanikezwa izipho ezingavamile ezivela ezulwini, waba umbusi kanye neqhawe elibonakala sengathi lihlobene nokudalwa uqobo. Indaba yabo ihlanganisa isiprofetho, ubukhosi, kanye nobuciko, ishiya ifa elizwakala emakhasini esambulo saphezulu.
clues: Ngakhethwa njengenceku ka-Allah futhi nganikwa umbuso onamandla phakathi kwabantu abakhethiwe.
Izintaba nezinyoni bezizovumelana nami ekudumiseni oPhezukonke.
Insimbi yaba thambile njengobumba ezandleni zami, ngentando ka-Allah kuphela.
Ngakha izivikelo zokuzivikela ezazivikela amasosha ngesikhathi sempi.
Ngake ngadlula esivivinyweni esinzima lapho abantu ababili abaphikisanayo bengena ngokuzumayo endaweni yami yokukhulekela.
Ngikhulunywe kanye nombusi owayala umoya namajini — ngoba lowo mbusi wayeyinzalo yami uqobo.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Abantu ababili abaphikisanayo bangena ngenkani endaweni yami yokukhulekela
Ngabhekana nozamcolo omkhulu owabhubhisa abantu bami
Wavivinywa ngokulahlekelwa yiwo wonke umndeni nengcebo
trial.answer: Abantu ababili abaphikisanayo bangena ngenkani endaweni yami yokukhulekela

location.label: Isici Esiyinhloko
options: Insimbi yenziwe yaba lula ezandleni zami
Ingadi enhle kakhulu enezinhlobo ezimbili zemikhiqizo
location.answer: Insimbi yenziwe yaba lula ezandleni zami

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Wathola amaHubo (Zabur) futhi wamiswa njengombusi olungile
Wasindiswa esiswini senhlanzi futhi abantu bakholwa
Ngibuyiselwe empilweni futhi nginikezwe izibusiso ezengeziwe
outcome.answer: Wathola amaHubo (Zabur) futhi wamiswa njengombusi olungile

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
